title: Deadline and Asset
author: Sebastian Halloran
blurb: Noor Brightwater, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
